display_switches.description: List of display switch arguments. Common values: --progress, --timer, --eta, --rate, --bytes, --average-rate, --buffer-percent, --line-mode, --bits, --gauge, --numeric, --quiet. See pv(1) Display switches.

format_string.description: Custom format string for the progress display (e.g., '%t %b %r %p'). Overrides display_switches if non-empty. See FORMATTING section in pv(1).

si_units.description: Display and interpret suffixes as multiples of 1000 (SI) rather than 1024 (IEC). Corresponds to --si.

wait_for_first_byte.description: Wait until the first byte has been transferred before showing progress or calculating ETAs. Corresponds to --wait.

delay_start.description: Wait this many seconds before showing progress. Can be decimal. Corresponds to --delay-start.

total_size.description: Total amount of data to be transferred in bytes. Suffixes K, M, G, T supported. Can start with @ to specify a filename. Corresponds to --size.

use_bits.description: Use bits instead of bytes for counters. Corresponds to --bits.

line_mode.description: Count lines instead of bytes. Corresponds to --line-mode.

update_interval.description: Seconds between updates. Can be decimal. Corresponds to --interval.

average_rate_window.description: Seconds window for average rate calculation. Must be integer. Corresponds to --average-rate-window.

terminal_width.description: Assume terminal width in columns. 0 means auto-detect. Corresponds to --width.

terminal_height.description: Assume terminal height in rows. 0 means auto-detect. Corresponds to --height.

name_prefix.description: Prefix the output information with NAME. Corresponds to --name.

bar_style.description: Progress bar style: plain, block, granular, or shaded. Corresponds to --bar-style.

output_file.description: Write data to FILE instead of standard output. Corresponds to --output.

rate_limit.description: Maximum transfer rate in bytes per second. Suffixes K, M, G, T supported. Corresponds to --rate-limit.

buffer_size.description: Transfer buffer size in bytes. Suffixes K, M, G, T supported. Corresponds to --buffer-size.

no_splice.description: Never use splice(2) system call. Corresponds to --no-splice.

last_written_bytes.description: Show the last NUM bytes written. Corresponds to --last-written.

skip_errors.description: Ignore read errors by skipping past offending sections. Corresponds to --skip-errors.

error_skip_block.description: Error skip block size when using skip_errors. Suffixes K, M, G, T supported. Corresponds to --error-skip-block.

stop_at_size.description: Stop transferring once total_size bytes have been written. Corresponds to --stop-at-size.

sync_output.description: Synchronise buffer caches to disk after every write. Corresponds to --sync.

direct_io.description: Set O_DIRECT flag on inputs/outputs. Corresponds to --direct-io.

watch_fd.description: Watch file descriptor FD of process PID. Format: PID:FD or just PID. Corresponds to --watchfd.

remote_pid.description: Remotely control another pv instance with this process ID. Corresponds to --remote.
